seed: Prefer the simplest stateless rule set. Treat every object type that never changes in the data as static scenery and model only the types that change.

synth.notes:
Single mirror axis (3-row wall band at block row A) + 3x3-block pieces; parse model, step, layered render (wall<target<reflection<piece), re-extract.
ACTION5 cycles axis -> pieces (sorted by min block) -> axis; selection visible as 0 hole fills.
Selected axis: A1/A2 move A by -/+1 block (A3/A4 no-op); selected piece: A1-4 move 1 block, blocked by bounds/other pieces.
Piece blocks above the axis reflect to block row 2A-r (clipped, skipped on piece blocks); targets/counter static scenery. Passes stateless too.
Unconfirmed: selection order beyond the first piece, reflection of blocks below the axis, pieces moving onto the axis row.
